thesis: APPN is a real, fundamentally backed momentum leader: revenue is up 25.47% YoY and accelerating, net income swung to +12.3M, the 5 Nov earnings gap came on 2.0M shares, and the stock is above SMA20/50/200 near its 57.26 52-week high. But it is 8.4% above the SMA20 with ATR at 5.7% of price, in a risk-off regime (confidence 0.8) where tech is the lagging sector (XLK ret_21 -10.2%). Zone-based R/R is about 1.87 (14.0 reward vs 7.5 risk from the 53.9 mid-entry), but at the last close of 55.58 it is only about 1.34 (12.32 vs 9.18). Per lesson 1, a pullback setup with R/R below 1.5 at the last price is held at Hold, and the bull's own target probability is just 0.30. Re-rate to Overweight if price fills the 53.0-54.8 zone and holds above the SMA20 (about 51.2).
invalidation: A daily close below 46.63 (the 3 Nov swing low) breaks the higher-low structure; a close under the SMA20 (about 51.2) on rising volume is the early warning.
key_risks: Risk-off regime with tech, semis and long-duration growth lagging; ^TNX at 5.141 (1y pct 0.914)
